data.name: Double
data.description: As a move action you can create an illusory double of yourself. This double functions as a single mirror image, and lasts for %1 rounds, or until the illusory duplicate is dispelled or destroyed. You can have no more than one double at a time. The double created by this ability doesn't stack with the additional images from the mirror image spell.|WarpriestLVL
